All things went so well and Christmas is coming, but she cannot feel a little bit happy.

Depression? Orin doesn't understand the word, but that sounds terrible.

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36049944/f211ba380a6e03bcf8399e92058b23253bae8157.jpg

Dear Ibunseki Players,

We're happy to inform you that in the v1.0 of this game, AI level selection will be added to both story mode and free play mode. Including:

Easy - AI will use at most 1 card per-turn and will not use card to grab Suwako; player gets Ran and Marisa's passive skill as bonus at the beginning of the game. Player's fortune stays above "Normal" throughout the game. Abnormal states will last at most 1 turn for all players;

Normal - AI will use at most 1 card per-turn and will not use card to grab Suwako;

Hard - AI may use multiple cards within 1 turn and will use the cards to grab Suwako as their priority.

We've received some players complaining about "This game takes side at the AI." We're sorry to hear that but we should still say we did not make that design, all things just happened randomly. 

Wish you a good luck! And enjoy the game ~

Team L.U.R.Id Glow

notes.title: Update v0.9.0 - Online mode stabilized, Chapter 7 updated
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36049944/2b58568cb4f3117d547fa475cd1874d66cd032ba.jpg
Caution: The saved game of older versions CANNOT be loaded this version. Please finish the game before you update, or you can just delete the saved game files. 
Or you can just overwrite the old save files with the new ones.
A game crash is highly likely to happen if you persist on loading old saving files. Deleting the saved games will not affect the unlocking process of the game (mission and characters).

HOW TO DELETE OLD SAVED FILES
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36049944/5d608e1dcf97bbd41ac1bcc969928681a57ca6fd.jpg
Path: [USERNAME]/Appdata/Local/THAD_Re_v1_0_0
Delete saved games: All files in [game_save] folder.
Delete online saved games (BETA version only): All files in [multiplayer_save] folder. 

Make sure you delete the files while the game is running, or Steam Cloud will auto recover the files.

------Now the main course------

Dear Ibunseki Players,

A long time has passed and we're back to update the game again!

ONLINE MATCH
This time, we've got a major change in the online game!
The stability of online mode has been largely improved - after a month's testing and debugging, there is little chance that of game crash during the online mode!
We've also adjusted the character's skill to make the game more balanced~ Check out what is changed for your favourite characters~
Here's how to get and play the online version.
[HOW TO GET]  
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1138100/announcements/detail/2372781945492685635
[HOW TO PLAY]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1138100/announcements/detail/2372781945494101320
[S/L in ONLINE MODE]
Online mode is now with Save/Load feature, you can stop the game anytime you want, and continue the game later.
[USAGE]
1.The autosave feature is enabled for online match, the saving files are stored on the host machine.
2.To restore the game, the host should first load the game, then all other clients connect to the host.
3.All the players should use exactly the same [Name] of the saved game if you want to join.
4.If not all the players are available, you can choose a COM to replace this player.
CHAPTER 7
This update also contains Chapter 7 - "At Sixes & Sevens". Story, maps and new character Fujiwara no Mokou & Houraisan Kaguya!
We've also added summary interface after the finishing of free mode.
2 new functional road blocks have been added - Remi/Flan's Blood Donation Place. Please have a look at them in the Map Editor!

And now you can take a screenshot with F12 key
The image will be stored in [GAMEPATH]\Screens

Thank you and so sorry for keeping you waiting so long, we'll do our best to update the game!

Merry Christmas!

Team L.U.R.Id Glow
Dec. 25th 2020

notes.title: An Update after April Fool's Day
notes.notes:
Dear Ibunseki Players

I don't know if you have believed in the news we published on April Fool's Day.

Welp, actually the man who write the news is so bad at lying, except for "the illustrator will be replaced" item. All the other news are true.

Yes, we're now under developing of online versus mode.
Yes, 粗茶 and 玉之けだま will join us in the develop of the game, along with another one.
And yes, you can play Ludo in Ibunseki style later in the updates.

So why is "illustrator being fired" stuff a fake news? Welp, he is the BOSS of the dev you know :D:D:D

Team L.U.R.Id Glow is a four-man group that making Ibunseki after their daily work is done. So it will take longer to develop the game. We planned for bi-weekly updates, but, well, things changed more often than you can expect. But we will never abandon the project as there are many players watching and waiting for its accomplishment. It will, probably, take even longer time if we begin making the online mode. But just believe us, we will make it to the end :D



Oh, BTW we made a small update includes:

[olist]
 Fix display errors of dice in the Yaokai Battle;
 Fix the manga display error;
 Optimize AI and increasing game speed.
[/olist]


Thanks for all you guys for the support!

Sincerely,
Team L.U.R.Id Glow

Apr. 3rd, 2020
